build_QDTrack_model: build a QDTrack model with detector, track_head, and tracker configs for multiple object tracking
predict_QDTrack_tracking: run QDTrack predict on a video tensor to get tracking results per frame
loss_QDTrack_training: calculate QDTrack training losses including RPN, ROI head, and tracking head losses
review_QDTrack_init: review the QDTrack __init__ to understand detector, track_head, and tracker module construction
refactor_QDTrack_freeze_detector: refactor QDTrack to toggle freeze_detector flag for freezing detector weights during training
